entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Casts the reliance as bodily weight put on a support, carrying the hint that the one leaning could not stand unaided.
examples: We can lean on this man

entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The faintest of the set, confidence as expectation turned toward a thing without the weight *lean* or *bank* place on it.
examples: Look to your friends for support

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Admiration that puts the object above the one feeling it; plainer and more informal than *venerate*.

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Makes the jumble something you are inside and lost in, with an intricacy *tangle* does not suggest.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The same gay feeling with an outward, jolly noise on it that *gaiety* need not have.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Homely and affectionate where *good sense* is flatly commendatory, though the soundness praised is the same.

entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: On this sense it asks only for sadness, short of the weight *grieve* insists on.

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The flat, full-weight name for the act, leaving the premeditation showing where *dispatch* and *remove* tidy it out of sight.

entries.definition: something that baffles understanding and cannot be explained
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The plain word for what defeats understanding outright, and the one that can carry wonder alongside the bafflement rather than only frustration.
examples: how it got out is a mystery

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: One cold slang syllable, the deliberate act shrunk to a word too small to hold it.

entries.definition: trouble or confusion resulting from complexity
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Names both the trouble and the confusion together, and locates the cause in complexity rather than in the person confused.

entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Shares the suffering from slightly above it, so the warmth carries a downward tilt that *sympathize with* has not.

entries.definition: a disposition free from stress or emotion
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Even and unruffled, the absence of emotion sounding closer to a settled flatness than to any achievement.
